hypothesis: The integration of agentic AI into clinical trial design can enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the research process by enabling autonomous hypothesis generation, experimental design, and data analysis, thereby addressing the complexities of trial execution and improving predictive accuracy of outcomes. This approach not only allows for the exploration of novel methodologies but also facilitates interdisciplinary synthesis, potentially leading to significant advancements in medical research and therapeutic development [2503.08979:1][2508.14111:10.1].
